decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, three light-blue dots, red X lit. The car is moving up-screen on grass between pines, with a trunk immediately front-left and the tarmac band (with posts) visible to the left; another lit road band with white posts runs across the top-right.
decision.hypothesis: Momentum is decent and the car is aimed at the gap ahead; steering left would strike the trunk. Plain throttle should carry it forward to where the lane crosses.
decision.memory: At 7 mph in the woods with trunks flanking, keep holds plain — steering into a trunk dead-stops the car.
